# Imogen Hale

Environmental health officer at Brackenmouth Borough Council. She carries out our food hygiene inspections under the Borough Food Hygiene Rating.

## How We Work Together

- Unannounced inspections; she asks for the [[food-safety-management-plan]], the daily check sheets and the cooling log first, then walks the basement before the café.
- Clear and fair. She explains the reason behind each point and accepts photos as evidence of a fix.
- Email for follow-up; she replies within a week.

## Current Threads

- None open. The rating is back at 5 since the re-rating visit on 2025-10-07.
- If unit 7 at Saltings Market Hall goes ahead, it would be registered as a separate food business and inspected separately. I asked her by email in July 2026 whether a hall counter fed from Hollowgate counts as one business or two; her informal answer was two registrations, one plan that covers transport between them ([[saltings-market-hall-unit-7]]).

## History

Rated us 4 out of 5 at the [[environmental-health-inspection-2025-06-18]]: incomplete cooling records for the new cooked fillings and the basement hand-wash sink blocked by flour sacks. The [[haccp-plan-rewrite]] team revised the plan to version 3.1, and she re-rated us 5 on 2025-10-07.
